question: Which one of the following was the only Rajput state that defied Mughal power?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mewar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Mewar** was the only Rajput state that consistently defied Mughal power during the height of their empire. It became a symbol of resistance against Mughal dominance.

• Under the leadership of renowned rulers like **Maharana Pratap**, Mewar refused to accept Mughal suzerainty, unlike other Rajput states that eventually allied or submitted to the Mughals.

• The **Battle of Haldighati** (1576) is one of the most notable events where Mewar, led by Maharana Pratap, fiercely resisted the Mughal forces led by Raja Man Singh, a general of Akbar.
